purpose: Extract the exact same action-equivalence and componentwise immediate-cost dominance rule used by the Mini-ORIGIN response-cost quotient into a domain-independent Bellman search transformation, then test it without external data on three structurally different exact-search families before any later fresh external transfer gate.

frozen_transformation.equivalence: Actions are comparable only when their canonical outcome signatures are identical: same successor states in canonical order with the same branch weights.
frozen_transformation.dominance: Within one equivalent-outcome class, action A removes action B iff every aligned immediate outcome cost of A is <= B and at least one is strictly smaller.
frozen_transformation.tie_break: If aligned cost vectors are exactly equal, retain the action with the lower deterministic tie rank, then lexical action id.
frozen_transformation.continuation_assumption: Continuation value depends only on successor state; path aggregation is monotone in nonnegative immediate costs.
forbidden: domain-specific dominance predicates inside the quotient engine
using external benchmark data in v0.89
changing the quotient after seeing one family's evaluation results

families.name: adaptive_diagnosis
families.description: Finite hypotheses, adaptive multi-outcome tests, hypothesis masses and outcome-dependent nonnegative test costs; terminal when a single hypothesis remains. State includes remaining tests.

families.name: weighted_set_cover
families.description: Deterministic exact weighted set cover; state is uncovered universe and selecting a set transitions to the remaining uncovered elements.

families.name: acyclic_shortest_path
families.description: Deterministic weighted shortest path on a generated layered DAG; state is the current node and an edge transitions to its head.

evaluation.baseline: exact memoized Bellman recursion over all available actions
evaluation.candidate: the identical recursion after the frozen generic quotient is applied independently at every state

interpretation_if_pass: Evidence that the frozen quotient is implemented as a domain-independent exact search transformation and transfers mechanically across three synthetic families. It is not evidence that the rule itself is novel and is not yet a fresh external Stage-5 success.
interpretation_if_fail: The generic-transfer abstraction is rejected as implemented. Preserve the failure; do not retune this v0.89 gate after observing family results.
